# Skills Manager collection

This collection was imported from the local Skills Manager 2.1.9 skills directory. The original skill files and supporting assets are kept together under `skills/`; per-skill `source.json` records attribution and license metadata stated in the source file.

**98 skills were inventoried; 97 skill contents are included.** The Anthropic PowerPoint skill is deliberately excluded: its bundled proprietary license explicitly prohibits copying and distribution. Its inventory entry is retained in `metadata.json`.

For skills with no license declaration, this import records only the attribution present in the local file. Do not interpret inclusion in this collection as a license grant. Confirm usage rights before redistribution or modification.

## Provenance and updates

This is a snapshot of the local Skills Manager collection, not a live mirror of one upstream Git repository. The manager configuration listed ClawHub as a marketplace, but did not establish the source repository for every installed skill. Each skill is therefore committed separately and includes a `source.json`; source URLs are recorded only when present in the skill metadata.
